verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local LLM inference engine: SSD expert offload, a routing predictor, LoRA adapters, and an OpenAI-compatible serve endpoint. Defining event-triggered automation rules is a workflow-automation capability outside this product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Edge0 ships any rules or triggers feature that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
